data.description: A Yellow Berry Bush is the wild bush you pick for [yellow berries](/items/yellow-berry), which you can eat or use to mix tea. To find yellow berries in Rust, look in forests in temperate, tundra and jungle biomes. Each pick gives one berry plus one [yellow berry seed](/items/yellow-berry-seed) for planting your own, and sometimes a [worm](/items/worm) or, more rarely, a [grub](/items/grub). Food caches can hold 1-6 berries too, at about a 15% chance.
